# Sona

Last updated: 2026-10-29. For recent data, [use our API](https://enrichlayer.com/pricing).

## Overview

Sona is the next-generation workforce management solution for large frontline operators, where consumer grade design is matched by AI-driven decision making. The company serves frontline organizations in industries including social care, hospitality, and retail, and offers a different product range in the US and the UK.1

Combining end-to-end WFM functionality (including Scheduling, Time & Attendance, HR and Payroll) with truly intelligent AI capabilities, Sona enables real-time actionable insights geared towards driving revenue and increasing employee satisfaction. The platform includes an AI assistant called Raffy, which explains what is happening, why it matters, and what managers should do next.2

Sona is privately held, and its most recent funding was a $45.4 million later-stage venture round in March 2026.3
